affected_callers: Codex native subagents running V4 no_skill, old_skill, and new_skill conditions
The parent Harness recording native-agent provenance and invoking blind scoring
The V4 analyzer that reconstructs and replays every candidate diff
Maintainers running the repository-local V4 verification commands

acceptance_criteria.condition: V4 deterministically materializes the preregistered 10-task corpus with all four cleanup trap strata and both repair/decision-retention cohorts.
The runner and analyzer reject score forgery, candidate-diff changes, sequence violations, extra/retry artifacts, replay mismatches, and invalid native-agent provenance.
All package regression tests, pytest, compilation, static analysis, Skill structure validation, and whitespace checks remain green with no PYTHONPATH requirement for the V4 typecheck.
The experiment is hash-bound before its first trial and explicitly scopes its trusted-parent, shared-filesystem isolation limit.

invariants: Each task has exactly three preregistered conditions in a fixed per-task order; a later condition cannot be prepared before all predecessors receive blind scores.
The repair agent receives only its condition workspace and applicable frozen Skill snapshot; hidden tests, references, scoring rubric, prior output, and condition outcome remain unavailable.
A collected result is eligible only when frozen corpus replay, candidate-diff replay, hidden scoring, scorer provenance, sequence credentials, and agent provenance all agree.
The parent Harness is trusted for native identity and transcript recording; this is protocol isolation on a shared filesystem, not container isolation or cryptographic attestation.

The frozen protocol establishes a future bounded effect experiment only; it does not establish an improvement in model-wide causal ability, general repair success, or production reliability before collection and analysis complete.
replaced_paths: Unbound native-agent completion records without V4 prompt, workspace-handoff, transcript, and condition-input provenance
Trust in stored score pass/fail booleans without independent candidate-diff replay
V3 partial-collection practice as a source of effect claims

safeguards.name: frozen preregistration
safeguards.rationale: The preregistration records task IDs, order, frozen inputs, model/Harness scope, stopping rule, and immutable envelope hashes before collection.

safeguards.name: predecessor-score chain
safeguards.rationale: Preparation is blocked until each earlier condition is blind-scored, and the next condition records predecessor score hashes.

safeguards.name: hidden-test timing
safeguards.rationale: Only the public workspace reaches the agent; the scoring copy receives hidden tests after the agent exits.

safeguards.name: replayed scoring
safeguards.rationale: The analyzer rematerializes the frozen corpus, reapplies candidate.diff, and compares rerun public/hidden output against the canonical score.

safeguards.name: independent review
safeguards.rationale: A read-only native reviewer retested the bare typecheck, focused suite, JSON parsing, scope statements, and declared threat boundary.

design_boundary.rationale: Materialization, collection/score sequencing, preregistration, and analysis remain separate deterministic modules.

dependency_audit.rationale: The update uses only the Python standard library, existing Git, existing tests, existing basedpyright, and the existing Skill validator.

extension_decision.rationale: No production extension point or new public runtime abstraction was added.

data_ownership.rationale: The change creates deterministic test fixtures and local evidence, not mutable business or personal data.

error_model.rationale: Missing, stale, extra, forged, replay-divergent, or out-of-order artifacts make the collection ineligible instead of silently accepting partial evidence.

contract_evolution.rationale: V4 defines a new, fresh task set and protocol without reinterpreting the frozen V10 corpus or prior invalid collections.

operational_budget.rationale: The V4 focused suite completed in 28.299 seconds; the full unittest suite in 72.806 seconds; pytest in 75.96 seconds; agent trials are capped at 300 seconds and scoring at 20 seconds by preregistration.

threat_boundary.rationale: The protocol detects local score/diff/replay inconsistencies but explicitly leaves parent-Harness trust and non-cryptographic transcript provenance outside its threat model.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The frozen change has verification outputs, hash-linked evidence, independent review, and an atomic Lore commit pending publication.

release_recovery.rationale: No deployable service, feature flag, or production release changed.

data_migration.rationale: No production persistence format, schema, backfill, or migration changed.

configuration_secrets.rationale: The new pyright configuration contains only static-analysis paths and diagnostics; it contains no secret, runtime credential, or environment value.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No dependency manifest, lockfile, package version, or third-party runtime dependency changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README and the preregistration record the execution boundary, trap coverage, and limitations necessary to run or interpret V4.

reproducibility.rationale: V4 inputs are hash-bound, the corpus is rematerialized during analysis, and the V4 bare typecheck is configured in pyrightconfig.json rather than an ambient environment variable.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert the V4 scripts, corpus manifest, frozen snapshots, tests, README paragraph, pyrightconfig.json, and evidence record together if a separately verified experiment supersedes them. Do not turn a partial or ineligible V4 collection into an effect claim; retain its raw artifacts and mark it ineligible.

independent_review.notes: The independent reviewer reran the bare typecheck and focused tests, parsed the configuration and preregistration, and confirmed that README plus preregistration accurately limit the claim to trusted-parent shared-filesystem protocol isolation.

remaining_risks: No V4 trial has run yet, so this artifact proves protocol readiness rather than a Skill-effect result.

A local party able to rewrite every raw artifact and recompute its hash chain can alter transcript provenance under the declared trusted-parent model; external append-only attestations or container isolation would be required for a stronger claim.

Thirty task-condition runs provide only a bounded comparison for the fixed model, Harness, Skill snapshots, corpus, and scorer; they cannot prove model-wide causal ability or production repair success.
A failed, interrupted, incomplete, or protocol-invalid collection must remain ineligible with no selective retry.
